description: Election Commission - Correction Notice for the Gaz. Ex. No. 2061/42-1  09.03.2018
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to the names of returned members for local authorities elections, specifically referencing the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the Election Commission's authority under Section 66(2). The content deals with electoral processes and candidate registrations, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7). While it mentions commission members by name, this is incidental to the electoral content rather than constituting a government personnel appointment with portfolio responsibilities.
